item.title: AFCON Round of 16: 2 countries eliminated from tournament
item.description: Two countries have been eliminated from the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON, Round of 16 stage in Morocco. DAILY POST reports that the two countries are Sudan and Tunisia. item.title: Cult, gang groups sign peace accord, renounce violence in Cross River
item.description: Several cult-related and gang groups in Cross River State have signed a peace accord, pledging to renounce kidnapping, violent clashes, and other criminal activities. The agreement followed a peace walk organised by the Homeland Safety and Security Agency through the streets of Calabar, the state capital. item.title: ‘He’s gone’ – Thousands of Venezuelans celebrate Maduro’s removal across globe
item.description: Large crowds of Venezuelans living abroad poured onto the streets of major cities around the world on Saturday to celebrate the removal of President Nicolás Maduro, following a U.S. military operation that ended his rule. item.title: UN Security Council to meet after US military intervention in Venezuela
item.description: United Nations Security Council is set to hold an emergency session on Monday following the recent U.S. military operation in Venezuela that led to the removal of President Nicolás Maduro.
